name: Mindustry
hint: Multiplayer server for the factory and tower-defense game, joined over IPv6

SERVER_NAME.title: Server name
SERVER_NAME.description: Players need build 160 of the game. They join from Play, Join Game, Add Server with the app's address (port 6567 is the default), then pick it under Remote Servers. The address is IPv6-only, so players need IPv6 on their network.
